Exam Date & Time: 03-May-2025 (02:30 PM - 05:30 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  FOURTH SEMESTER B.TECH. (ELECTRONICS AND COMMUNICATION ENGINEERING) DEGREE EXAMINATIONS -  
  APRIL / MAY 2025  
  SUBJECT: ECE 2223 / ECE_2223 - ANALOG INTEGRATED CIRCUITS  
  ANALOG INTEGRATED CIRCUITS [ECE 2223]  
Marks: 50                                                                                                      Duration: 180 mins.  
  
  A  
Answer all the questions.  
  
1A)               Design a circuit using a single op-amp to get the output voltage expression: V O = 3V1 + 4V2 - 1.5V3 (4)  
  - 2.5V4 , where V1 , V2 , V3 , and V4 are input voltage sources. Provide the circuit diagram with  
  suitable resistor values.  
1B)               Draw the internal block diagram of op-amp and explain its different stages.                              (3)  
1C)               i) Draw the circuit used to measure the output resistance of an op-amp and derive the formula for        (3)  
  calculating it.  
  ii) If the output voltage of op-amp is 10 V without a load and drops to 9.52 V when a 1 kΩ load is  
  connected, calculate the output resistance of the op-amp.  
2A)               Design a 4th order low-pass Butterworth filter with a passband gain of 30 dB and cutoff frequency of (4)  
  2 kHz. Use C = 0.01 µF. Determine the roll-off rate in the stopband by computing the gains in  
  decibels at 5 kHz and 50 kHz.  
2B)               For the given circuit, sketch the equivalent circuits corresponding to the positive and negative half-   (3)  
  cycles of the input signal. Perform an analysis for each case and draw the resulting output  
  waveform if the input is 5 sin(314t).  
  
  
2C)               Analyze the given circuit and determine the currents iO, i1 , and i2 for load resistances                (3)  
  $$i) R L = 1 kΩ,$$  
  $$ii) RL = 2 kΩ and$$  
  $$iii) RL = 4 kΩ.$$  
  
  
  Page 1 of 3

3A)   Analyse the following Circuit. Sketch V P , VC, and VOUT with respect to trigger signal VIN of pulse   (4)  
  with T1 . Also derive expression for pulse width of the output.  
  
  
3B)   An ideal comparator is shown in Figure below. A sinusoidal signal of 8 V peak to peak with the         (3)  
  frequency of 1kHz is applied as an input to the comparator. Draw the output waveform and find the  
  duty cycle.  
  
  
3C)   Design a first order wide band pass filter having fL =400Hz fH=2kHz and band pass gain of 4. Draw      (3)  
  the frequency response of the filter.  
4A)   With neat circuit diagram and equations explain how 555 timer can be used as FSK generator             (4)  
4B)   Derive the 8-bit digital output equivalent to an analog voltage of 5V for a dual slope ADC, which has (3)  
  a maximum integrator output of -6V when the input voltage is 10V  
4C)   Design a 4-bit binary weighted resistor type DAC whose full-scale output voltage is -10V. Logic        (3)  
  level 1 = +5 volts and logic level 0 = 0 volt. Determine the output when the input is  
  i) 1001 and  
  ii)1101.  
  What is the resolution of the DAC designed? Select R = 10kΩ  
  
  Page 2 of 3

5A)              With the neat block diagram and necessary wave form, explain how PLL can be used for AM              (4)  
  detection.  
5B)              Explain with the circuit diagram, how LM317 can be used as Adjustable Voltage Regulator?             (3)  
5C)              Derive the expression for output voltage of an instrumentation amplifier with suitable diagram.      (3)
